title: Outbound message envelope (any producer -> the hub)
description: What a producer (a CI system, a scheduler, a research job, ...) publishes. Drop it as one JSON file in <spool>/out/. The hub routes it to channels by config, renders it per channel, and logs every delivery.

schema.description: telefi.* is current; notifly.* is accepted while producers migrate

id.description: unique per message; the spool file is <id>.json

source.description: producing system, e.g. ci, scheduler, research

title.description: the headline: what happened, one line (aim for <= 90 chars)

sections.description: details as data: each a heading and short lines, rendered inside the collapsed details

silent.description: override: true = no notification sound. Default: silent when the status dot is green or blue

evidence.description: what an investigator needs, shown under the body

ref.description: e.g. a run id, issue number, task name

links.description: rendered as buttons that open the URL (no inbound needed)

actions.description: buttons; a tap becomes an inbound.v1 event routed to `namespace`'s sink

input.description: ask the owner for free text first (ForceReply); the reply arrives as payload.note

dedup_key.description: same key inside the dedup window = delivered once

insight.description: the plain context: what this is, where it stands and why it matters. Shown under the headline.

next_step.description: what the reader should do now, in plain words. Expected on anything that asks for attention (telefi/wording.py). Shown after 'What to do:'.

not_before.description: ISO time; the hub holds the message until then (a grace period for an automated fix)

dedup_window_min.description: this message's dedup window; default: the hub's dedup_window_min

delivery.description: now (default): send when routed. batch: if it would reach Telegram, hold it for the next batch window (08/12/16/20) instead; a sender can only make a message calmer, never louder. digest is the old name of batch. critical severity and kind blocker always go now.

template.description: optional message template (docs/MESSAGE_CATALOG.md): with `facts`, TeleFi owns the wording, links and buttons. Free-text envelopes omit both.

facts.description: the template's typed facts, validated against telefi/templates/<template>.json; unknown or missing facts reject the envelope
